Description: Richomeres is a Frankish figure connected with the western Roman army and court. He is concerned with how officers can clarify disagreements without immediately accusing one another of disloyalty. He wants another report before judging a situation and distinguishes caution from mere delay, especially with impatient colleagues. Maintaining support requires service he can actually provide, while followers need food, reward and safety. An order that reserves glory for its author and blame for its executor makes him wary. He wants his judgement heard before a decision rather than being given responsibility only after it fails.
